law_name: Copyright Law, Title 35, Chapter 1 of the Code of the Federated States of Micronesia (originally Public Law 2-29, 1981)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years; anonymous works shorter of 100 years from creation or 75 years from publication
fair_use_exceptions: Fair use limitation (s. 107); FSM Government works excluded from copyright (s. 105)
notes: Berne since 7 Oct 2003 (Commons). Foreign-work protection tied to nationality, treaty or proclamation (s. 104). WIPO Lex marks some Title 35 editions as superseded (2014 annotated edition covers ss. 101-126).
